Getting to know SVS

A college is somewhere you spend a part of your life

The course matters. So do the people you learn with and the place you come back to each day.

SVS brings together medical, dental and nursing colleges in Mahabubnagar, alongside a teaching hospital, nursing hospital and dental clinics.

If you’re getting to know us for the first time, start with the college you’re interested in. Then take a look around the campus.

Meet our colleges →

Finding your way

Know your way around

The colleges sit in three separate compounds. Here’s a quick guide to what’s where, including dining and hostel arrangements.

The hospital and clinics

Where the classroom meets clinical care

The teaching hospital is part of the medical compound. Nursing has its own hospital, labs and wards; dentistry has clinics within its separate campus. These clinical spaces are an important part of understanding SVS.

01

Teaching Hospital

Connected to the medical college compound.

02

Nursing Hospital

Dental Clinics

For students and parents

A way to stay in touch with college life

Moving to college is a change for the whole family. The planned Student & Parent Smart Portal is intended to make academic updates and campus notices easier to follow.

The app and login services are in development. You can look at the proposed experience here.
